project_type: 4A Store v2 — monorepo folder with api-node (Express + TypeScript + Prisma/MySQL) backend and mobile (Expo / React Native / expo-router) app
build_system: api-node: tsc (npm run build). mobile: Expo SDK 54 / React Native 0.81, tsc for typecheck, Gradle for APK/AAB. No workspace tooling linking the two; each has its own package.json and node_modules.
test_framework: api-node: NONE (no test script; verification is tsc build + prisma validate). mobile: node:test via a custom loader at mobile/src/__tests__/register.mjs that mocks '../api' and '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage'; it ONLY loads pure-TS modules under mobile/src/__tests__/**/*.test.ts and does NOT render React screens.
